exit: 0
--- stdout
Print the canonical content id of a CXF document or an authored sequence.

Stdout is the id and a line feed, exit 0. A text or wire file is validated and emitted first, as emit does. An input that cannot be read, parsed or loaded has no id: exit 2 with the JSON report.

Usage: oce id [OPTIONS] <FILE>

Arguments:
  <FILE>
          The input: CXF (`.jsonld`, `.cxf.json`), text (`.oce`) or wire (`.json`), or `-` for stdin

Options:
      --from <FROM>
          The input form; overrides the name, and is required for stdin
          
          [possible values: cxf, text, wire]

      --render <RENDER>
          When to write a human-readable rendering of the report to stderr
          
          [default: auto]
          [possible values: auto, always, never]

      --namespace <NAMESPACE>
          The instance namespace a text or wire file is emitted under, as for emit. A namespace never moves the id; one whose IRIs the engine refuses leaves the document with none

      --json
          Print the JSON report, with content_id, instead of the id line

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')

  -V, --version
          Print version
--- stderr
